notes.title: Dark World Free 1 Week!
notes.content:

We are excited to announce that the exclusive "Dark World" mode, usually reserved for players who have purchased a DLC, will be available for free for all players for 1 week! 🌑✨

notes.title: Discover our roadmap!
notes.content:
[h1]📢 Important announcement! 📢[/h1]

Hello everyone! 🎮

We are pleased to announce that the game's [b]official roadmap[/b] is now available! You can take a look now to see what we have planned for the coming months and beyond. 🎉

[h2]What's in store for you:[/h2]
- [b]Q4 2024:[/b] Improvements to the [b]Dark World DLC[/b], daily and weekly rewards, and an exciting new bonus: [b]life or death[/b]. New in-game content and events will also be on the way! 
- [b]Q1 2025:[/b] Get ready for the addition of [b]multiplayer[/b], exclusive [b]Steam Achievements[/b], and many new features, such as character customization and player leaderboards. 🎮
- [b]Q2 2025:[/b] Discover a [b]new pirate world[/b], a [b]platform mode[/b], as well as the [b]Steam Workshop[/b]. Enough to push your limits!

Remember that the roadmap is constantly evolving and adjustments may be made over time to ensure an optimal gaming experience.

👉 [b][url=https://trello.com/b/jO6C1arQ/through-time-public-roadmap]Check out the roadmap now[/url][/b] and stay tuned for upcoming updates!

Thank you for your support and see you soon in-game! 🎮✨

notes.title: Content update
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the release of our new game update! Here are the main new features and improvements:

[h1]Gamepad support is no longer supported[/h1]
- [b]Attention:[/b] We would like to inform you that the game no longer supports gamepads. Please use your keyboard and mouse to continue playing.

[h1]Menu improvements[/h1]
- [b]Enhancements menu:[/b] Based on your feedback, we have modified the interface of the enhancements menu to make it clearer and larger. We hope this will improve your gaming experience.
- [b]Game mode selection menu:[/b] Also based on your feedback, we have modified the game mode selection menu to make it more intuitive and easier to navigate.

[h1]New Game Mode[/h1]
- [b]Exclusive Game Mode:[/b] A brand new game mode is now available, playable only on Sundays. DLC owners can play it at any time. Get ready for a thrilling new experience!

[h1]New Achievements to Unlock[/h1]
- SNOW WORLD
- DESERT WORLD
- DARK WORLD
- ???
- EXTREME MODE

We hope you enjoy these new features and improvements. Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback that helps us improve your gaming experience.

Happy gaming everyone!

The Development Team

End of controller support
New improvement page
New game mode selection page
Minor bug fixes and optimization

notes.title: MEGA UPDATE !
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 Update Available for Our Game! 🎉[/h1]

We are excited to announce the latest update to our game, bringing many new features and improvements for an even more exciting gaming experience!

[h2]🌌 New World: Theme of the Night[/h2]
[b]- Available for free for 2 weeks![/b]

- [b]Lots of experience[/b]: Reach level 6.
- [b]Improvement![/b]: Improve a bonus.
- [b]Indestructible[/b]: Improve invincibility bonus to maximum level.
- [b]Resurrection[/b]: Improve life bonus to maximum level.
- [b]Bunny Jumps[/b]: Improve the jumping bonus to maximum level.

We hope you enjoy these new features and improvements. Thank you for your continued support and have fun!

The development team

notes.title: The dark world is coming!
notes.content:
On July 19, the new dark world is released.
It will be available for 2 weeks for free if you have reached level 6, at the end of the event, only owners of the DLC will be able to access it.

Additionally, on July 28 you will have access to several new dark world game modes, which change daily. They will still be available to owners of the DLC.

- Fixed the bug that stuck your game in the loading screen
- Fixed a bug that caused your character to get stuck when he died and therefore did not end the game
- Fixed a translation bug in the "Progress" page
- Fixed explanatory text for learning to play for touchscreens
- Fixed the bug where music cut out without restarting

- Adjustments to music in infinite mode, there is now one music per world and in a loop.

notes.title: Removal of DLC
notes.content:
Dear players,
We just want to inform you that the DLC "Through Time - Sound Pack" will no longer be available.
This DLC was badly configured on our side and did not give you any advantage in the game, which is why it will be removed and replaced soon by new DLCs.
Since the DLC is free, you won't get any in-game compensation.

Thank you for playing the game!
The entire game team wishes you a Happy New Year 2023!

notes.title: Update 4.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone !
A sensational update has just arrived, radically transforming your gaming experience. The development team is proud to present new features that will thrill your senses and raise the level of your virtual adventure. Buckle up, because this is what awaits you!
Goodbye to sonic monotony! Immerse yourself in the action with an enriched playlist, offering a variety of music that plays randomly. Now every gaming session is a unique musical experience!
For just 1 euro, unlock the ability to choose your favorite game mode with the Steam extension. No more limitation of daily rotation, room for diversity and excitement by choosing from the various game modes!
Two exciting new worlds are added to the existing two. Discover the mysterious desert world, followed closely by the dark world. These worlds will gradually open up, each bringing its own set of unique challenges. In addition, already known worlds have been improved with new obstacles, such as the dreaded snowy stone in the snow world.
Unlock new worlds by increasing your account level. Start your adventure in the tropical world and make your way through ever more captivating environments.
A new in-game bonus allows you to instantly change worlds, giving players unprecedented freedom. Compete against other adventurers and climb the leaderboards, with your scores saved under your Steam or Gdgames username.
For mobile gamers, controls become more intuitive. A simple gesture up or down is now enough to jump or slide, inspired by the game mechanics of Subway Surfers. Ads are no longer just an interruption, but an opportunity to unlock new game modes.

We have big ambitions for the future of gaming, with new regular worlds, daily quests, new music, innovative game modes, new Steam expansions, and even support for Steam cloud saves .
In 2024, the game will be normally available on Poki Games, with future plans for the Epic Games Store, Apple Store, Amazon Games, Microsoft Store and even on Xbox. Get ready to experience adventure on new platforms!
Dive into this monumental update and prepare for endless adventures. Thanks for being part of our gaming community, and may the excitement continue! 🚀🎮

notes.title: Update 3.2.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone ! I'm delighted to announce the latest update which contains lots of new features! 🎉

New update! (3.2.0)
- 3 new languages available! German, Italian and Chinese! You can change the language in the settings menu.
- From now on you will be able to consult your current level on the main menu, in the mode selector and at the end of a game. It is no longer necessary to go to the Progress page to view your level. You will also see your progress towards the next level in bar form.
- I made some adjustments to optimize infinite mode. The game should be smoother and more stable, and the levels more varied and balanced.
- Touch controls are no longer displayed for PCs and devices without a touch screen. This should improve the gaming experience and avoid confusion.
- Steam achievements are coming! The 3 currently available achievements are unlockable, there will be many new ones in the next updates! You can view achievements in the Steam menu and soon in the Game Progress page.
- Other minor changes, like bug fixes, graphics improvements, sound changes, etc.

Coming soon: Settings page (with quite a few settings) and challenges page (daily, weekly, monthly challenges). And arrival of weekly and monthly game modes!

I hope you enjoy this update, and continue to play and support me! Do not hesitate to let me know your feedback, your suggestions, or your problems encountered. I thank you all for your loyalty and enthusiasm! 😊

notes.title: Update 3.1.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone ! I am delighted to announce that the next update (3.1.0) will be available soon to give you an even more fun and varied gaming experience! Here's what awaits you in this new version:

- A limited game mode that changes every day! This is normal mode but with a few rule changes that will spice up your game! For example, there will be a 100% chance of bonuses appearing, which will allow you to boost your performance and break your records!
- Your best score will be displayed in the game mode selection page, so you can see your progress and compare yourself to other players!
- A button to the upgrade page in the game mode selection menu and on the main menu, so you can upgrade your bonuses more easily and make them even more effective!
- Many bugs fixed, such as the bug that automatically launched the game when you clicked on the play button, or the bug that displayed your gold balance with too many decimal places. We also fixed the bug that changed the main menu music after a second, and optimized the infinite mode code to make it smoother!
- A backup of your choice of language, so that you don't have to reset it every time you launch the game. You can also change the language in one click using the little flag in the main menu!
- Visual particles when you collect a bonus or when you jump on a platform, to make the game more beautiful and more dynamic!

We hope you like this update and enjoy playing my game! Do not hesitate to give us your feedback and suggestions, we are always listening to our community! Thank you for your loyalty and see you soon for new adventures!

notes.title: Patch 3.0.1
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with the replay button in infinite mode.
Added some files for future updates.

notes.title: Update 3.0.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I am the game developer of A Travers Le Temps and I am very happy to announce the release of the new update that will revolutionize your gaming experience! Here's what awaits you in this version:

- Complete overhaul of the main menu, now it's much easier to use. You can access all the options in one click, change game modes easily, and customize your profile as you see fit.
- Added the "Progression" tab which allows you to follow your level in the game and easily see when you move to a new level. And soon you will also be able to consult your statistics, your successes, and your rankings.
- Removed challenge mode and store. We decided to focus on the core of the game, which is infinite mode. We believe that the challenge mode did not provide enough variety and challenge, and that the store was not necessary to enjoy the game.
- Added Steam overlay and Steamworks SDK integration. This means you'll be able to share your screenshots, and take advantage of Steam-exclusive features like the Workshop, trading cards, and badges.

We hope you enjoy this update as much as we enjoyed creating it. Do not hesitate to share your feedback, suggestions, and possible bugs with us on our Steam page. Thank you for your loyalty and good luck to all!

notes.title: Update 2.2.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here is the 2.2.2 update of my video game. This update brings several improvements and fixes:

- The game is now centered in the middle of the screen for devices with different resolution. This allows for a better gaming experience on all types of screens.
- The progression system has been modified, it is now easier to increase your score multiplier. You will earn more points based on your performance and level.
- Endless mode menus have been reworked. They are clearer and more intuitive. You can easily access the different game modes and leaderboards.
- It is now possible to watch an advertisement to double its rewards. If you want to earn more coins and bonuses, you can choose to watch a short video before receiving your rewards.

We hope you enjoy this update and continue to play our game. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: The mid-season update is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I am very happy to announce the release of my game update 2.2.0, which is a huge update. Here is what you will discover in this new version:

- A new way to play endless mode, with platforms that appear at different heights. Will you know how to jump at the right time so as not to die?
- A shop where you can spend your coins earned in the game to buy companions who will follow you in your adventures, and musical tracks to customize the sound environment of the game.
- A quick scroll bar in the menu, which will allow you to navigate more easily between the different menu options. No more scrolling through the menu to find what you're looking for!
- A more frequent rotation of game modes, which will offer you more variety and challenge. Now game modes will change every 1/2 day instead of every week. Be ready to adapt!
- Hints available when launching the game, which will give you useful information on how the game works, controls, bonuses, etc. If you are a beginner or if you want to revise your knowledge, this is the perfect opportunity!
- A surprise if you talk to Bertrant in the menu. I won't tell you more, but I assure you that it's worth it!
- The game language which is automatically set according to your device settings. No need to change the language manually in the game, it will adapt to your choice!
- Missing English translations that have been added. Sorry for the delay, hope you enjoy the game in English!

But that's not all ! Here's what's coming very soon in upcoming updates:

- Daily challenges, which will allow you to easily earn coins in the game by completing various and fun objectives. Every day, new challenges await you!
- The translation of the game into Spanish, so that our Spanish-speaking friends can enjoy the game in their native language. ¡Hola amigos!
- A new special bonus in infinite mode, which will give you a temporary advantage during the game. I won't tell you what it is yet, but I can tell you that it's going to make some noise!
- A new settings page, where you can modify certain aspects of the game according to your preferences. For example, you can enable or disable sound effects, music, vibrations, etc.
- The addition of new information displayed in infinite mode during the game, such as the number of coins collected, the time elapsed, etc. You will be able to follow your performance in real time!

Well, I hope you enjoy this update and that you enjoy playing my game. Feel free to send me your feedback and suggestions on social networks.
Thank you for your support and see you soon!

notes.title: Update 2.1
notes.content:
Hello to all players of my game! Today I am happy to announce the release of the new update, which brings many improvements and new features. Here is what you will discover:

- Bug fixes: we have eliminated several errors that could hinder your game experience or cause malfunctions.
- The translation of the game into English: to reach a wider audience and allow you to play with friends from all over the world, we have translated all the texts and dialogues of the game into English. You can choose the language of your choice in the options.
- The release of the game worldwide: until now, the game was only available in France, Belgium, Switzerland and Canada. Now you can download and play it anywhere in the world! We hope you enjoy this opportunity to share your passion with other gamers.
- Challenges mode temporarily disabled: we found that the challenges mode still had some bugs that could affect your enjoyment of the game. We have therefore decided to deactivate it temporarily, the time to correct and improve it. We apologize for this inconvenience and we will keep you informed of its next reactivation.
- Weekly challenges and updated weekly modes: to compensate for the absence of the challenge mode, we have renewed the weekly challenges and weekly modes, which offer you various challenges and exclusive rewards. Do not hesitate to try them and let us know your impressions!
- Modified music: we have also revised the music of the game, to give them a better sound theme and a better atmosphere. We hope you enjoy these new melodies that accompany your adventures!

That's it for this update! We hope you enjoy these changes and that you will continue to play our game. Don't forget to leave us a comment or a rating on the store, it helps us a lot to improve the game. Thank you for your loyalty and see you soon!

notes.title: La jungle débarque avec la saison 1 !
notes.content:
Bonjour à tous les joueurs et joueuses de A Travers Le Temps ! Nous sommes heureux de vous annoncer la sortie de la prochaine grosse mise à jour de notre jeu qui arrivera le 11/03. Cette mise à jour apportera de nombreuses nouveautés qui devraient rendre votre expérience de jeu encore plus agréable.

Tout d'abord, nous avons modifié le thème du jeu. Fini la neige, place à la jungle ! Cette nouvelle ambiance vous plongera dans un univers encore plus exotique et sauvage.
Ensuite, nous avons optimisé la vitesse de lancement du jeu. Vous pourrez désormais jouer plus rapidement et profiter encore plus de votre temps de jeu.
Nous avons également modifié le statut affiché sur Discord, pour vous permettre de partager plus facilement votre statut de jeu avec vos amis.
Le menu a lui aussi été entièrement repensé. Désormais, vous devrez vous déplacer pour sélectionner le mode de jeu. Avant le lancement du mode, des informations utiles apparaîtront pour vous aider à mieux appréhender le défi qui vous attend.
Les compagnons ont également été repensés. Chaque semaine, vous aurez la possibilité de relever 3 défis pour obtenir un compagnon. Vous pourrez également obtenir 2 compagnons par semaine avec les pièces (monnaie du jeu).
Le mode défis a lui aussi été amélioré. Des défis ont été ajoutés pour vous permettre de débloquer plus facilement des pièces et des étoiles. Certains défis ont plusieurs paliers et des paliers bonus, pour vous offrir encore plus de challenge.
Chaque semaine, un mode infini à durée infinie fera son apparition, avec des règles modifiées. Cela vous permettra de varier encore plus les plaisirs et de vous amuser encore davantage.
Enfin, nous avons ajouté 2 nouvelles musiques pour vous permettre de vous immerger encore plus dans l'univers du jeu. Et d'autres nouveautés vous attendent en jeu, que nous vous laissons découvrir par vous-même.

Nous espérons que cette mise à jour vous plaira et que vous prendrez autant de plaisir à jouer à A Travers Le Temps.
